name: Paris
limitations: Eight conditional60 judgments, not fully measured or a global rank. PCS/GSS/RES now use actual delivery and explicit scope/ordinary-resident assumptions. Actual local CAR-T makes the earlier AD-only LON40 pathway-representativeness assumption inadequate; capacity, manufacturing, toxicity, AD restrictions and costs remain. Current product payment continuity, eligible resident access/monitoring and disease-pathway relevance are reversible assumptions. 28partial/2context/1unresolved subpillars; rejecting LON yields54–64 without a centre.

dimensions.rationale: Actual June/July 2026 heat follow-up, cooling access, patrols and fan distribution plus a completed October 2025 flood drill support scoped adaptation. The drill’s March 2026 flood, 80,000 evacuees and interruptions are simulated. Actual regional 2025 heat harms persist; unreviewed hazards are not assigned zero.
dimensions.assumption: Observed major-hazard measures are relevant across the FUA and usually effective for the target resident through the cutoff. Unreviewed geophysical/severe-weather exposure does not constitute the dominant unmitigated vulnerability; reject to unknown, not zero.

dimensions.rationale: 2025 judicial/PNAT records distinguish national classified attacks and disrupted plots from Paris execution and international cooperation. Actual high threat, local high-intensity violence and state/strategic exposure remain. No national totals, unverified media events or absent UCDP matches are converted into a city rate.
dimensions.assumption: Scoped local execution and national classified monitoring/cooperation reasonably apply to the FUA through the cutoff. Realised organised-violence impact on ordinary life is generally limited despite important continuing regional/strategic threat; reject this impact inference to unknown.

dimensions.rationale: Actual municipal contact operation, heat follow-up, flood training and recovered hospital capacity support execution/adaptation. Contacts are not resolved requests; drills are not actual disaster recovery; group and coordination differences persist.
dimensions.assumption: Observed execution persists and ordinary residents generally reach key services across the area. Known coordination/group/recovery shortfalls remain important but do not create a broader unmitigated execution bottleneck.

dimensions.rationale: Actual water/food flow, regional electricity consumption and imported supply are joined with delivered water-cost assistance and current conditional energy-assistance paths. Electricity dependence, affordability and geography remain; historical model inputs and household means are not current median bills.
dimensions.assumption: Observed essential-resource flow and operator/region evidence reasonably represent usual resident supply through the cutoff. Ordinary median-income residents can generally afford essentials; reviewed help and residual costs do not create a clear usual-access bottleneck. Historical modelling is only scoped supporting context.

dimensions.rationale: Actual broad routine/specialist care and 460 annual-average reopened beds plus scoped quality processes and current public coverage support usual care. Certification is historical; medicine/testing reductions are processes, not clinical improvements. Financial/staffing, care-path and residual cash burdens remain.
dimensions.assumption: Necessary routine/specialist care is generally clinically adequate, obtainable and affordable under usual qualifying coverage across the FUA. Existing recovery and care organisation persist despite important waiting/group/pressure shortfalls; do not require perfect contemporary adjusted outcomes or bills.

dimensions.rationale: Pathway-selection correction: actual local CAR-T treatment, credible disease-specific human evidence, European regulation, French maintained hospital-list evaluation and insurance/monitoring paths challenge the old whole-dimension 40 based only on anti-amyloid payment gaps. Saturation, manufacturing delays, severe toxicity, monitoring and ancillary costs remain. HAS opinion is not a new final ministerial listing and no healthy-person lifespan gain is assumed.
dimensions.assumption: The disease-specific CAR-T path is relevant to limited LON readiness; clinical evidence is not a healthy-ageing benefit claim. Reviewed European authorisation and previously maintained French hospital-list/payment route continue through the cutoff; current adult CIP ministerial/liste-en-sus original was not independently obtained in this bounded review. Ordinary clinically eligible insured residents generally obtain appropriate local treatment and monitoring and can bear ancillary burdens despite saturation/manufacturing delays. Reject product/payment, access/monitoring/cost or spatial persistence to unknown.

dimensions.rationale: Scoped multi-hospital production/transfer income, actual professional digital use and public contact operation support knowledge/industry/diffusion. Private-sector withdrawal, financing/coordination and historically measured digital-group barriers require explicit persistence/importance assumptions after help; unknown stronger evidence alone does not cap the score.
dimensions.assumption: Observed production, licensing, clinical/public digital use reasonably represent limited sustained knowledge/industry/diffusion capacity across the area. Financing/coordination and dated group-access problems remain materially important after existing help. If mitigated sufficiently, assess 80 instead; unknown high-tier evidence does not itself justify 60.

dimensions.rationale: Actual airport/rail service and compensation, qualified French EU-citizen German residence paths and conditional bank/communications operation support usual exit. Weak lines, fees, account/identity conditions and common failures remain; ordinary use is not independent stress backup.
dimensions.assumption: Ordinary French citizens generally obtain/afford usable transport, a qualifying German EU residence purpose, approved compliant transfer accounts and key communications. Observed paths persist and reasonably apply across the FUA; no independent common-failure redundancy is presumed.
